ModMetaData.name: Teleport Vision Patch
ModMetaData.author: Shard
ModMetaData.description:
Small patch so that if one of your controlled pawns ends up teleporting into a location without vision, it reveals the area around them. If you are using my psycast range patch, this is already included and you do not need this mod.
Does not include any way to teleport through walls, you will need another mod for that.
